lemmas.primary_translation: hibernate in a den / withdraw completely from the company of others

definitions.text: om visse pattedyr: gå i vinterdvale i en hule
definitions.translation: of certain mammals: go into winter hibernation in a cave (lit. go into a den)

examples.no: bjørnen går i hi om høsten
examples.en: the bear hibernates in its den in the autumn

definitions.text: i overført betydning: trekke seg helt tilbake fra selskap med andre
definitions.translation: figuratively: withdraw completely from the company of others

examples.no: han går i hi når noe butter imot
examples.en: he withdraws completely when something goes against him
